source_refs.note: The text printed under heading 18.6: Correns, Sutton and the chromosomal theory of inheritance, as printed (PDF 100).

blocks.text: In 1900, German geneticist Karl Correns, rediscovered Mendel’s work and suggested the role of chromosomes in heredity. In 1902, American scientist Walter Sutton proposed the chromosomal theory of inheritance. This theory states:

items: Genes are found at specific locations on chromosomes.
The behaviour of chromosomes during meiosis explains Mendel’s laws of inheritance.
